title: Provide Deal Performance Feedback Response
description: Response payload for provide_deal_performance_feedback task. Returns either acknowledgment OR error information, never both.

oneOf.title: PerformanceFeedbackSuccess
oneOf.description: Success response — feedback received and acknowledged

acknowledged.description: Confirms the feedback was received and will be used for optimization

optimization_notes.description: Optional curator response describing any planned optimizations based on the feedback

oneOf.title: PerformanceFeedbackError
oneOf.description: Error response — feedback could not be processed

errors.description: Array of errors explaining why the feedback failed
